{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash

# Flux batch script (translated from PBS)

# PBS requested:
#   -N upload_torus
#   -S /bin/bash
#   -l walltime=48:00:00
#   -l nodes=1:ppn=1
#   -l mem=8gb
#   -o logs_u/${PBS_JOBNAME}.o${PBS_JOBID}.log
#   -e logs_u/${PBS_JOBNAME}.e${PBS_JOBID}.err

flux alloc \
  -N 1 \
  -n 1 \
  --time=48h \
  bash -lc '

mkdir -p logs_u

# NOTE: PBS mem=8gb has no universally portable Flux directive in a batch script.
# Performance implication: without a memory request/limit, the job may be placed where less memory is available,
# increasing risk of OOM or contention.

# NOTE: PBS job name (-N upload_torus) has no universally portable Flux batch directive.
# Performance implication: none (metadata only), but job identification in monitoring/accounting may be less clear.

# PBS output/error used PBS variables; approximate with fixed jobname and Flux job id.
exec >"logs_u/upload_torus.o${FLUX_JOB_ID}.log" 2>"logs_u/upload_torus.e${FLUX_JOB_ID}.err"

module load gcc/6.2.0
module load python/2.7.13

cd "${PBS_O_WORKDIR:-$PWD}"

gsutil cp -a public-read \
  /gpfs/data/im-lab/nas40t2/abarbeira/projects/gtex_v8/torus_eqtl_priors.tar.gz \
  gs://gtex-gwas-share/torus/torus_eqtl_priors.tar.gz

#rm /gpfs/data/im-lab/nas40t2/abarbeira/projects/gtex_v8/torus_eqtl_priors.tar.gz
'
"
}
